Geographies Served Programs Early Intervention Programme District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu Vasantham provides early intervention services for children aged 0-6 years, focusing on their development across multiple domains such as motor skills, play, understanding, and communication. The programme involves training both the children and their parents or caregivers, ensuring a comprehensive approach to support their growth and progress. Evaluation and Diagnosis of Developmental Disorders District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu The team at Vasantham comprises professionals such as special educators, speech and language therapists, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, vocational trainers, clinical psychologists, and other medical and allied health experts. The family of the individual also plays a crucial role and actively participates in assessments and intervention plans. Special Education Training District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu The organisation offers specialized training through special education, tailoring the instruction to each individual's needs through the use of Individualized Education Programme (IEP) goals. Standardized test materials such as checklists and profiles are utilized to set these goals for all students. Special Remedial Education District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu Vasantham provides special remedial education during evenings and weekends for individuals who are included in mainstream schools. This additional support aims to address their specific needs and ensure their successful inclusion and participation in the regular education system. Pre - Vocational and Vocational Training District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu Vasantham provides pre-vocational and vocational training to adolescents and adults with developmental disabilities, aiming to develop their skills, coordination, and livelihood prospects. Training includes crafts like weaving, painting, paper bag making, and candle making. The organisation also offers diverse healing activities such as communication therapy, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, play therapies, therapeutic dance and music, yoga, counselling, therapeutic gardening, field visits, and more. Outreach/Rural Activties District Perambalur State Tamil Nadu District Perambalur States Tamil Nadu Vasantham conducts outreach programmes to support families and children residing in remote areas. An ongoing community empowerment initiative has been implemented in Perambalur since 2020, focusing on providing assistance and resources to the local community. Milestones & Track Record Growing from 6 children in 1989 to supporting 121 individuals currently. Providing residential care for 50 individuals. Operating successfully for over 33 years. --> --> Leadership Team Smt Alli Murugesan Founder Director Dr. Krupa M Executive Director Smt. Elamathy School Principal Shri.
